props.description: An animated bar chart appears showing 1st, 2nd, and 3rd class survival rates. The y-axis starts at 0.55 (auto-scaled). The 1st vs 3rd class bars look like a dramatic cliff — 3x visual difference implied. A pulsing red label appears: 'Y-axis starts at 0.55 — not zero.' Then the y-axis smoothly slides down to 0 and the bars rerender at their true heights. The gap is real but not the cliff the auto-scale implied. Final text: 'plt.ylim(0, 1)' appears. The animation makes the deception and the one-line fix visceral.
